title: epilobium montanum proles lanceolatum
intro: Epilobium montanum proles lanceolatum, commonly known as Alpine Willowherb, is a plant species within the Onagraceae family. It is a perennial herb native to mountainous regions of Europe and Asia, characterized by its lance-shaped leaves and delicate white flowers. Alpine Willowherb has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as urinary tract infections and benign prostatic hyperplasia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including diuretic, antiseptic, and anti-proliferative effects.
